items.title: Decoding quantum errors with NVIDIA Ising Decoding on AWS
items.summary: Quantum computers today are fragile: they lose their quantum state to noise and decoherence faster than a useful algorithm completes. Quantum error correction (QEC) makes longer computations possible by encoding each logical qubit across many physical qubits, so that errors can be detected and removed without disturbing the encoded information.
